name: Black in AI — application support & fee waivers
institution: Black in AI (org, not a university)
fundingType: Application fee waivers + mentorship + travel grants
notes: DO THIS FIRST. Listed as a general fee-waiver route across many US CS departments. Open to African researchers (unlike GEM, which is US-citizen only). Runs a grad-application mentorship programme. One acceptance here can unlock waivers worth hundreds of dollars across several schools. VERIFY current cycle dates.

name: PhD Computing — Kahlert School of Computing
notes: HIGHEST PRIORITY. Merit-based application-fee waivers explicitly for INTERNATIONAL PhD applicants — genuinely rare. CRITICAL: request the waiver BEFORE paying; fees already paid cannot be refunded, and a waiver is valid only for the cycle granted. Strong systems/networking group. VERIFY 2027 waiver window opens (was live for Fall 2026).

name: PhD Computer Science
fundingType: Full tuition waiver + partial fee waiver + stipend, guaranteed 5 years
notes: In a recent cycle: GRE NOT required for doctoral applicants; international applicants paid only the $100 evaluation fee with the $70 application fee waived automatically for applications completed before mid-December. Funding guaranteed for first five years. Typical GPA threshold ~3.5 final two years. They explicitly encourage contacting faculty directly. VERIFY the fee reduction still applies for 2027.

name: PhD Computer Science
notes: Explicitly states PhD applicants may hold EITHER a bachelor's or master's. Low $70 fee. Limited PARTIAL waivers — you must submit the application first, then contact gradadmissions@cs.rochester.edu. Deadline was 5 January in the prior cycle. VERIFY 2027 date.

name: PhD Computer Science & Engineering
notes: States plainly that a master's is NOT required for the PhD, and that a related discipline is acceptable — computer engineering qualifies. Successful applicants usually have ~3.5/4.0 GPA and three strong letters. Non-US degrees are checked against their equivalency page — do that early. FA2027 fee waiver application expected to open in autumn 2026; check back.

name: PhD Computer Science & Engineering
notes: The GRADUATE DIVISION does not waive fees for any international applicant — but the CSE DEPARTMENT holds a limited number, awarded on contributions to diversity, social justice experience, and overcoming adversity. Financial need alone is explicitly NOT sufficient. Apply through the department form, not the grad division. Excellent networking and systems groups.

name: PhD Computer Science / ECE — Viterbi
notes: Waiver route is a plain email with CV and transcripts to viterbi.gradprograms@usc.edu — no citizenship restriction stated, which makes this one of the more open routes. Strong networking (ISI) and ML. Ask early, well before the deadline.

name: PhD Computer Engineering / CS
notes: College of Engineering has historically published a public fee-waiver CODE on its admissions page usable by any graduate applicant. Codes change yearly — check the page in autumn for the current one. Direct computer engineering department, so your degree maps cleanly.

name: PhD Computer Science / ECE
notes: Publishes a fee-waiver policy page. SUNY system — check whether the Ghana English-proficiency exemption that applies at Binghamton also applies here, since they share a system. Solid networking and systems groups.

name: PhD Computer Science / ECE
notes: CONFIRMED: Ghana is on their English-proficiency waiver list — no TOEFL/IELTS needed, given a bachelor's from an accredited Ghanaian institution with at least two years of full-time study. Good 'likely' tier anchor. Every application list needs one of these.

name: PhD Computer Science — CICS
notes: Fee waiver details sit under 'Application Fee' on the instructions page. Very strong ML and information retrieval. Check international eligibility explicitly — many such pages are domestic-only.

name: PhD Computer Science / ECE
notes: Fee waivers listed under 'Fee Waivers' on the grad admissions page. Huge ECE department — arguably the best direct match for a computer engineering degree in the US. Networking, ML and data systems all strong.

name: PhD ECE / Computer Science
notes: Graduate School publishes an application-fee page including waiver conditions. Large ECE department with strong networking and computer architecture. Traditionally takes many international students.

name: PhD Computer Science / ECE
notes: Graduate School has a dedicated fee-waiver information page. Strong ML, data science and networking. Check international eligibility on that page directly.

name: PhD Computer Science
notes: Fee waiver information is on the doctoral applications page. Smaller department, which can mean more individual attention to non-standard backgrounds.

name: PhD Computer Science
notes: BEST VALUE ON THE LIST. Graduate School states applying is FREE — no application fee — and you can start without official transcripts or test scores. All applications are automatically considered for funded graduate assistantships with no extra action needed. CS dept covers wireless networks, data science, ML, distributed systems, cloud — near-perfect match for your interests. They feature a PhD student from Ghana on their prospective-students page. English proficiency is required for international PhD applicants and waived only for US degrees, so ASK whether the Ghana exemption applies. Zero-cost application: no reason not to apply.

name: PhD Computer Science
notes: The PhD application is FREE — the fee waiver is applied automatically, no form needed. They run monthly virtual info sessions for prospective doctoral students (last Wednesday of each month, 10:00 US Central) covering assistantships and the application process — attend one, it is direct contact with admissions. Email csadmissions@iastate.edu for individual support. Another zero-cost application.

name: PhD Computer Science
notes: GRE not required and explicitly not considered. Deadline was 15 December, 10pm MST, with NO extensions and incomplete applications rejected. Fee is $80 for international applicants. CRITICAL: the CS department runs a fee-waiver programme aimed specifically at international students from countries facing economic hardship, capped at ~100 candidates and closing around 20 November — earlier than the application deadline, and first-come until the quota fills. In CU's engineering departments a FACULTY MEMBER can also request a fee waiver on behalf of a specific international applicant by emailing the grad office. That makes supervisor contact worth real money here.

name: PhD Computer Science — CCSE
notes: Part of the University System of Georgia. GRE not mandatory. Research clusters include generative AI and post-quantum cryptography. Minimum GPA around 3.25 undergraduate, with lower considered case by case. Requires Calculus II, Discrete Math and Data Structures coursework — your computer engineering degree should cover these; check your transcript. Kennesaw publishes a TOEFL/IELTS waiver policy allowing exemption after two years of full-time study at an institution whose primary language of instruction is English, with documentation. NOTE: some details here came from a third-party scholarship blog — verify everything against kennesaw.edu directly.

name: PhD — School of Computer Science
notes: Reported to offer NEED-BASED fee waivers to international applicants — you submit a letter outlining financial need with supporting evidence, and they waive fees for at most two programmes. If true this is unusual among top-5 departments, since most restrict waivers to citizens. Source was a third-party blog, so CONFIRM on cs.cmu.edu before relying on it. Long-shot admission, but a free long shot is worth taking.
